zones.label: Major road plus side streets
zones.intendedUse: Major-road casing with secondary/local side-street structure.

zones.label: High street
zones.intendedUse: High-street labels, named roads, bus/taxi/cycle/access tags where available.

zones.label: Suburban estate proxy
zones.intendedUse: Quieter residential/service-road blocks inside the current cached extract.

zones.label: Thames bridge
zones.intendedUse: Small future Overpass zone for Thames bridge context; may be empty in the local cached extract.

zones.label: Park edge
zones.intendedUse: Park/open-space edge, surrounding road labels, and learner orientation.

zones.label: Rail and station-heavy area
zones.intendedUse: Rail, station, public transport, and nearby road hierarchy.

zones.label: Awkward junction
zones.intendedUse: Junction geometry, crossings, one-way decisions, and restriction symbols.

zones.label: One-way system
zones.intendedUse: One-way-heavy local street pattern and decluttering checks.

zones.label: Learner route review context
zones.intendedUse: Base-map context under attempted/correct route and review warning overlays.

zones.label: Mobile viewport stress
zones.intendedUse: Narrow viewport road labels, one-way symbols, context labels, and touch targets.
